In many cultures, hills or mountains are considered sacred places, and the name Hilly can be seen as a connection to this heritage.

It reminds us of the resilience and determination that comes from within, and inspires us to persevere in the face of adversity. Additionally, the name is a reminder of our connection to the natural world and the peaceful, calming energy that comes from being in nature.
